'''Maximillian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] who lived in [[Aurilia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Maximillian appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
